                        IdeaMemberName = carrier.IdeaMemberName,

proposedParameterMeanings.memberNumber: Positive STAAD member ID, not a collection index; resolve from the acquired model.
proposedParameterMeanings.member: Member entity belonging to the acquired wrapper/model; snapshot its geometry.
proposedParameterMeanings.targetJointNumber: Positive target joint ID incident to the requested member.
proposedParameterMeanings.targetJoint: Target joint entity; require incidence to the member and the same model.
proposedParameterMeanings.loadCaseIds: Requested native case IDs; materialize once and validate availability and combination/result semantics.
proposedParameterMeanings.loadCases: Resolved same-model cases; preserve case kind, factors and result identity.
proposedParameterMeanings.jointNumber: Positive STAAD joint ID in the acquired model.
proposedParameterMeanings.joint: Same-model joint entity; retain its coordinate/unit context.
proposedParameterMeanings.mapping: Validated mapping for this exact joint and incident members, including basis, load position and active components.
proposedParameterMeanings.package: Owned mapped load package; validate model/mapping provenance, omitted components and equilibrium status before export.
proposedParameterMeanings.outputFilePath: Destination artifact path; validate format, directory, overwrite policy, staging and completed delivery.
proposedParameterMeanings.allowUnsafeExport: Explicit override of mapped export guards; default false. Preserve validation diagnostics and override provenance.
proposedParameterMeanings.staadModelPath: Model file identity for provenance; does not open a different model or prove saved/live state equality.
proposedParameterMeanings.ideaMappingSourcePath: Read-only mapping-source path for provenance and format validation.
proposedParameterMeanings.ideaCheckbotPath: Read-only Checkbot/mapping source context; not an instruction to modify or launch an IDEA project.
proposedParameterMeanings.request: Validated batch request with joint/case selections, outputs, failure policy, mappings, progress and cancellation.
proposedParameterMeanings.groupName: Node-group name resolved against the acquired model; do not silently select another group.
proposedParameterMeanings.options: Validated discovery filters/options; document geometric criteria and deduplication.
proposedParameterMeanings.jointIds: Selected native joint IDs; materialize, validate and deduplicate deterministically.
proposedParameterMeanings.results: Owned force/result rows with explicit frames, units, case IDs and extraction/validation status.
